body.name: \(q\)-state latent, heterogeneous-observed double-triangular class \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{DT}}^{(q)}(K,J)\)
body.construction: \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{DT}}^{(q)}(K,J)\) is the class of graph--law pairs \((G,P)\) satisfying the measurement-graph, Markov, faithfulness, positive-latent-support, measurement-nondegeneracy, categorical double-triangular, third-view-coverage, and subset conditions for fixed \(q,K,J\), where \(H_k\in\mathcal Q\), \(X_j\in\mathcal X_j=\{0,\ldots,m_j-1\}\), and every \(m_j\ge q\).
